key_points: Acme's announcement on 2026-09-20 introduced an Enterprise assistant with an availability window set for October 2026 for Enterprise plan customers.
Confirmed features for the new assistant include centralized administrative controls and a direct integration with Acme Data Workspace.
The announcement completely omitted essential procurement details, including pricing structures and official security certifications.
Operational and deployment boundaries remain unknown, as the announcement did not state geographic availability, performance benchmarks, rollout phases, or deployment requirements.
